pages.text: The first real fights, and they pay in diamonds.$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Zombie / Skeleton / Creeper$(): 800 to 1,200 HP, Overworld at night.$(br)$(bold)The Conjurer$(): 900 HP, a theatre in a Dark Forest. Fight through the illagers first.$(br)$(bold)Ferrous Wroughtnaut$(): 1,200 HP, the Wrought Chamber underground.

$(bold)Frostmaw$(): 1,500 HP, snowy mountains (the big pile of fur).$(br)$(bold)Lord Pumpkinhead$(): 2,000 HP, a Born in Chaos structure.$(br2)Also watch for Born in Chaos horror mobs, Illager Invasion and Raided raids, and It Takes a Pillage outposts. Raids are much worse than vanilla.
